cases.title: cancelling a parent task propagates to child tasks
preconditions: a parent task has at least one running child task
both tasks are owned by agents reachable through the same Bus
steps: send cancel for the parent task
observe the parent task state and every child task state
collect the audit events for the task tree

expect.notes: Every running child MUST receive cancel and reach cancelled; the audit trail MUST record the propagation.

cases.title: delegation whose budget exceeds the parent remainder is rejected
cases.notes: examples/task.json leaves 8000 ms; the child asks for 9000 ms. The spec requires the child budget to stay within the parent remainder but defines no delegation-specific error code.

cases.title: child result whose schema differs from result_schema is rejected
cases.notes: The parent task declares result_schema osap.calendar.proposal/v1; the result claims osap.calendar.propose/v1.

cases.title: peer mode without session_id is rejected
cases.notes: envelope.schema.json requires session_id when task.mode is peer (standard.md §8.4).

cases.title: peer cannot exercise the other participant's capability
cases.notes: The envelope sender is the orchestrator, but the capability is bound to the calendar peer; a session identity MUST NOT lend the other party's authority.

cases.title: handoff of an L3 action without renewed consent is rejected
cases.notes: L3/L4 handoff MUST obtain a fresh receipt whose audience is the new owner; examples/handoff.json carries no consent receipt.

cases.title: exceeding the delegated budget returns TASK_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
cases.notes: constraints.max_budget in examples/capability.json allows 5000 ms; the adapter reports 6000 ms already consumed.

cases.title: unfinished tasks do not silently stay running after a Bus restart
preconditions: a task is in running state with no terminal result
steps: stop the Bus without completing the task

expect.notes: The task MUST become failed or be rescheduled by policy; silent running is non-conforming and the recovery MUST be audited.

cases.title: crash after effect intent is marked unknown and not replayed
preconditions: an L2/L3 task has recorded effect.intent
the implementation is stopped before effect.executed is recorded
steps: inspect the task state and the audit trail
verify whether the side effect was repeated

expect.notes: The effect and task MUST be marked unknown; automatic replay is forbidden until reconciliation (§8.11).

cases.title: original owner cannot keep sending requests for a handed-off task
cases.notes: After an accepted handoff the original owner MUST relinquish control; the request from agent://com.example.orchestrator/main#1a2b is rejected.

cases.title: rejected handoff leaves task ownership and budget unchanged
cases.notes: A rejection is a valid one-shot result, not a protocol error; the task MUST stay with the original owner with identical state and budget (§8.9).
